buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 4. Generic Installation, Commissioning, Testing, Configuration, Training (if any - which ever is applicable as per scope of supply) is to be carried out by OEM / OEM Certified resource or OEM authorised Reseller. 5. Generic NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to be uploaded with bid: 1. I M/s. ____________ hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provision, specification, plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party during and after expiry of Contract. 2. If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 6. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the

additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 7. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses To participate in the bid, the following documents/certificates to be submitted : (a) The bidder has to upload the certificate of acceptance of all the terms and conditions of the bid alongwi th the bid reference number. (b) Items will be delivered as per the specifications mentioned by the user. (c) Bids submitted by different firms from the same IP address will be rejected. (d) Missing details, if any, will assumed as per good Engineering practice and will be provided by the vend or after being approved by Commanding Officer 115 Engineer Regiment. Whenever there is a variation bet ween technical specification and drawing, drawing will take precedence. (e) Sample of all items will be physically approved before commencing the work from CO 115 Engineer Re giment. No additional time will be granted for sample approval. (f) In case of any ambiguity in any given technical specification Vendor must clarify the same from CO 115 Engineer Regiment or detailed Engineer rep before participation in bid through representation on GeM. (g) Payment Terms - Payment will be done after complete delivery, commissioning and testing of items an d acceptance by Board of Officers. (h) In case of any ambiguity in any given technical specification Vendor must clarify the same from CO 115 Engr Regt or detailed Engineer rep before participation in bid through representation on GeM. (j) The work is to be executed in a restricted defence area, the Vendor will be responsible for providing do cuments required for entry into the restricted area. No additional time will be allowed with respect to exec ution for the same. (k) Unloading & stacking of stores on site will be responsible of contractor. (j). Delivery & Installation (Supply & Fixing) * All items listed in the BOQ must be supplied, unloaded, placed, and fixed at the designated site by the Se ller. * Inclusive Pricing: The quoted bid price shall be deemed all-inclusive of hardware, brackets, tools, labor, tr ansportation, transit insurance, and any miscellaneous accessories required for complete fixing. No extra p ayment will be made for fixing materials. (l) Broken items will not be permitted to be unloaded and will be rejected. (k). Quality Control & Authorizations. Product catalogue of OEM for verification of specifications of complet e items to be submit at the time of bid submission. Prior to bulk delivery/installation, the successful bidder must present samples to the Buyer for approval. Material supply must strictly match the approved sample s. (l). Site Visit. Site visit can be organised for the interested bidders as per gem terms and conditions. (m). Inspection & Payment Terms. 100% payment will be released only after successful supply, and fixing and formal Satisfactory Acceptance / Completion Certificate issued by the Buyer’s designated officer. Any i tem found damaged, defective, or not complying with the BOQ specifications during inspection must be re

placed by the Seller at no additional cost within 7 days. (n). Site Protection & Cleanliness. The Seller shall take all precautions to avoid damaging the Buyer's prem ises during installation. Any damage to the structure, paint, or electrical lines caused during delivery or ins tallation must be repaired at the Seller’s expense. The Seller must clean the site and remove all packaging , off-cuts, and debris upon completion of the work. .
